concerns.text: The `review_active_seconds` metric (time from first review comment to PR merge) requires a timestamp for the first review comment, but the `Raw PR Dataset Schema` (`raw_prs.schema.yaml`) does not include any field capturing comment timestamps (only `comment_count`). Without this variable the metric cannot be computed as described in the plan, making the chosen dataset inappropriate for that part of the analysis. Add a field (e.g., `first_comment_timestamp`) to the raw schema or adjust the metric to use only available data.
